floor_history.headline: Recon: floor=9 reconfirmed on pin-free candidate; m2c shows target reconstructs WITHOUT a load-temp (direct inlined stores) and WITHOUT the v1 pointer alias — an untried structural shape; sibling func

Structural sweep (13 forms). Floor held at 9; killed 8 named structural levers; walking-pointer lowers score to 7 but adds an insn so it's architecturally blocked from match — proves the RA tiebreak I

frontier.hypothesis: The target's flip is driven by pre-call RA state, not the post-call cluster shape. Something upstream of the call (arg saves, sp[] setup, alias liveness) sets the initial hard-reg freelist so the post-call allocator opens with the opposite ordering.
frontier.mechanism: Post-call RA state inherits the pre-call freelist; if the freelist has $v0 marked USED-recently (or $v1 free-longer), the mask pseudo gets $v0 as first-fit.
frontier.next_probe: Sweep pre-call variants: (a) reorder the 5 pre-call global stores (D_800F117C/1178/1180/A3468 + *v1) — the ordering is not semantically constrained; (b) hoist the arg1 halfword loads into a single copy pattern; (c) declare a callee-save-eligible local pinned pre-call (via structural declaration, not asm). Measure each with sandbox.

frontier.hypothesis: The extra addiu in walking-pointer form could be absorbed via a walk-and-restore pattern (`s32 *p = arg0; ... *p++ = ...; ... = *p--;`) — sometimes GCC collapses adjacent inverse addiu.
frontier.mechanism: If two addiu ops on the same register net to zero across a scheduling window, combine may drop both.
frontier.next_probe: Try `p = arg0; D_800F1140 = *p++; D_800F1144 = *p++; D_800F1148 = *(p--);` variants and confirm insn count. If it lands 43, the walking-pointer's score-7 becomes a real candidate.

frontier.hypothesis: The score-7 walking-pointer form contains 6 non-insn-add diffs; identifying which 6 differ (register names on which insns) narrows the remaining tiebreak axes.
frontier.mechanism: Compare tmp/sandbox/func_800611A4/text1b.o disasm (walking-pointer form) against asm/funcs/func_800611A4.s: register-name diffs are RA axis; ordering diffs are scheduler axis.
frontier.next_probe: Diff the walking-pointer objdump vs target line-by-line; classify each of the 7 diffs. That reveals whether the residual gap is 6 register-renames + 1 insn-add, or 4 renames + 3 reorderings + 1 add — steers the next lever choice.
